description: Aloisio the New's burial cathedral of the tsars (1505-08): a white two-tier box with Venetian scallop shells in its keeled zakomary, a heavy cornice between the tiers and pilasters on the bay lines; a gilded central onion and four silver domes; the round chapels at the east corners, the south gallery and barrel-roofed chapel, and the south-east buttress.
